reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE ol.product_id = p.product_id
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-05 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-12 00:00:00'
)
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM products
WHERE product_id NOT IN (
  SELECT ol.product_id
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-05 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-12 00:00:00'
)

WITH week_products AS (
  -- one row per product sold in the week
  SELECT DISTINCT ol.product_id
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-05 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-12 00:00:00'
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN week_products w ON w.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE w.product_id IS NULL

)
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p

WHERE w.product_id IS NULL
other_way.tradeoff: A step that lists the products sold that week, joined with LEFT JOIN, shows that list but takes more lines.
